name: Security Audit Checklist
description: A lightweight security audit workflow: run sanitizer, dependency scan, check for secrets in staged changes, and produce remediation steps.

steps.title: Run sanitizer
steps.description: Run scripts/sanitize.py to find obvious secret patterns.

steps.title: Dependency scan
steps.description: Run dependency vulnerability checks (safety, npm audit, etc.).

steps.title: Staged diff secret scan
steps.description: Scan staged/uncommitted diffs for high-risk changes.

steps.title: Produce remediation plan
steps.description: List files to sanitize, suggest credential rotation, and CI changes.
